# Business Mentors NZ

> Business Mentors NZ is a not-for-profit organization providing free mentoring services to help small businesses, startups, and social enterprises in New Zealand succeed through expert guidance and strategic support.

Business Mentors NZ connects business owners and entrepreneurs with experienced volunteer mentors across New Zealand. The organization partners with MBIE and other key stakeholders to deliver mentoring programs tailored to different business types and stages of growth.

## Key Topics

- Business Mentoring
- Startup Mentoring
- Small Business Support
- Mentor Matching
- Social Enterprise
- Entrepreneurship
- Business Growth
- Business Coaching
- Mentee Registration
- Volunteer Mentors
- New Zealand
- MBIE Partnership
- Business Guidance
- Nonprofit Support

## Getting Started

- [Business Mentors NZ](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz): Homepage for Business Mentors NZ mentoring services for small businesses and startups
- [Find a Business Mentor](https://content.businessmentors.org.nz/mentee-registration-lp): Mentee registration and mentor matching for business owners seeking support
- [Choose a Mentor](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/choose-a-mentor): Mentor directory and selection portal with skills-based matching
- [Choose a Hub](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/choose-a-hub): Hub selection and onboarding portal for Business Mentors platform users

## Mentoring Programs

- [Business Mentoring For Small Businesses](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/small-business-mentoring): Small business mentoring services and support from Business Mentors NZ
- [Startup Mentoring](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/startup-mentoring): Startup mentoring program with strategy and networking support
- [Social Enterprise Mentoring](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/social-enterprise-mentoring): Mentoring services for not-for-profit and social enterprise organizations
- [Gift a Business Mentor](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/give-the-gift-of-guidance): Gift mentoring program offering 12 months of Business Mentors support

## Become a Mentor

- [Become a mentor](https://content.businessmentors.org.nz/mentor-application-lp): Mentor application and volunteer recruitment for Business Mentors NZ

- [About Business Mentors](https://www.businessmentors.org.nz/about-business-mentors): Organization overview of Business Mentors NZ not-for-profit mentoring service
